## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Validation

- Mac chip and macOS version:
- Checks run and results:
- For UI changes: affected tabs, manual checks and screenshots with private data removed.
- For collector/performance changes: source/formula changes, sampling overhead and hardware limitations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows existing project conventions.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed, or failures/untested paths are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and meaningful regression checks were updated where needed.
- [ ] Attachments contain no credentials, private paths or unredacted OS logs.
